tools.name: screen_address
tools.description: Screen a crypto wallet address for AML/KYT risk. Returns an AML score (0-100), risk_level (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), category, sanctioned exposure and source-of-funds. Read-only: it only looks the address up, it never changes anything.

tools.name: trace_funds
tools.description: Follow the OUTGOING funds from an address across the chain and report where the money ends up (exchanges, mixers, sanctioned wallets) and how many hops away. Read-only: it only reads on-chain history, it never moves or changes funds.

tools.name: list_counterparties
tools.description: List the counterparties an address has transacted with — optionally filtered by entity category (cex, mixer, gambling, bridge, ...). Set with_risk=true to attach AML risk per counterparty. Read-only: it only lists existing on-chain counterparties, it never writes anything.

tools.name: trace_source_of_funds
tools.description: Walk an address's INCOMING funds backwards to answer 'where did this wallet's money come from'. Stops at labelled entities (exchanges, mixers, services) and reports them with hop distance. Answers source-of-funds questions. Read-only: it only reads on-chain history.

tools.name: screen_transaction
tools.description: Screen one transaction by hash: what moved, who took part, a label and AML risk for every participant, and an overall verdict. Pass focus_address (e.g. your own deposit address) to get the verdict from that wallet's point of view. Read-only.

tools.name: follow_swap
tools.description: For one transaction that went through a DEX or aggregator, show the net balance change per address and asset and flag who the swap was actually for. Use it to continue a trace past a swap. EVM chains (ethereum, bsc). Read-only.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: A wallet's recent transfers, newest first, with direction and counterparty for each, plus what we know about each counterparty. Optionally only transfers with one kind of counterparty (e.g. 'did this wallet deposit to a casino'). Read-only.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "screen_address" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
